j1.head: 6ecbf3a2e174408eae0d1a0354a7fe7df843fcc6
j1.summary: medium gate: audit 0 problems; fresh tree lock, check, real and test finals; three ticket controls replayed and caught; controller mutations c1 (hidden attribute only), c2 (references miss targets inside the item) and c3 (scan root loses its attributes) all caught; independent review found no high or medium issue; real smoke 10 indexed junctions, 0 hidden+system
later: spec trade-off (W13 1.1): a normal link whose target is written through a compatibility alias (for example ...\Local Settings\Temp oo) no longer resolves to the real item, so that item is not marked referenced; record for the next contract touch
tests: "hidden-system links remain skipped" is vacuous on the shared fixture (the isolated block covers it); "does not use index capacity" overclaims with one link (code order is right)

real_smoke: expect() panics if an indexed link disappears before the attribute re-read; the 0 is trivially true when no compatibility junction is enumerated; a seen-and-skipped count would show the filter ran
public wording: tests/scan_v1.rs helper m13_expected_cluster_id keeps a milestone tag; real_smoke imports std::os::windows unconditionally (Windows-only CI, fine today)

r1.head: a3629e9b739a7592ba514ec3b24f9a6a19dcef06
r1.summary: light gate: first return BLOCKED on a controller manifest omission (no productionFiles, so the rules data was outside the production snapshot); addendum 01 added them; both ticket controls re-collected red then green with different production hashes; check, test and real finals on 504bd856 (doc commit on top of the implementation 5e833287); audit 0 problems; product files scanned clean of private names; 119 observation refs dated and public, data version 2026-11-08.1, 118 rules
later: some observation refs that were only internal ids were rewritten from the rule description (for example the Audition conformed-files reference); facts and numbers kept, wording reviewed

s1.head: e7ea9a9e3eb2aac5fa0634e32c65ea9a4ecdf49e
s1.summary: medium gate: audit 0 problems; fresh tree lock, check, real and test finals; three ticket controls replayed and caught; controller mutations c1 (N = 0 wording reverted), c2 (quarantined summary written with nothing moved) and c3 (English native failure reason) all caught, no timing rerun; independent review found no high or medium issue; on main after all four merges the service tests pass 12/12 (79 s, then 95 s after the test-data tidy)
later: an old plan prepared before a skip returns stale with the generic "结果已过期，请重新体检后再清理。"; the UI then marks the whole (fresh) conclusion stale although re-preparing the plan is enough; check in integration 11 and fix in the UI or the stale code
tests/service_v1.rs keeps two ticket-era comments ("Addendum 05", "Before W10-M12 ... since M12"); tidy with the post-merge public wording pass
the new card filter for fully skipped leak units is redundant with the eligible-size check; the cluster test protects clue and trends, not the card
service_trends_locations moves the fake clock 60 s past the second scan; a scan slower than 60 s real time would still race (an hour would remove it)
the not-run batch stores journal_error from e.to_string() (English); it never reaches the UI (diagnostics only checks presence)
callers still extend stale_plans after invalidate_skips did the same (harmless duplicate)
